stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome aboard, Jaden Newbigging - the club is glad to host Wagga City GC today. Enjoy every hole.

stories.title: What On Earth Happened
stories.detail: +4 on hole 2 - the scorecard needs a moment to recover from that

stories.title: A Very Thorough Hole
stories.detail: +7 on hole 4 - a comprehensive, detailed, expensive visit to that part of the course

stories.title: Four and Forgotten
stories.detail: Quadruple bogey on hole 6 - the committee has been informed and they are also confused
